Should the widget flag be a per-visit latch or a remembered setting?
❯ 1. Per-visit latch              ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
    (Recommended)                 │ arrive via settle        -> armed        │
  2. Latch + remembered           │ arrive via shortcut      -> off          │
    preference                    │ leave (any route)        -> cleared      │
                                  │ app restart              -> off          │
                                  └──────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                  Notes: press n to add notes
